title: Benny’s Magical Key
moral: Curiosity and friendship lead to magical adventures.

scenes.summary: Benny finds a magical key and decides to explore.
scenes.text: Benny the bunny found a glowing key in the meadow and decided to discover what it could open.
scenes.image_prompt: cute bunny holding glowing key in meadow with flowers, bright magical cartoon style

scenes.summary: Benny does not know what the key opens.
scenes.text: Benny wondered what the key was for and decided to search for a hidden door near the old oak tree.
scenes.image_prompt: bunny thinking while holding key near big tree, colorful children illustration

scenes.summary: Benny and Tilly travel together to find the door.
scenes.text: Benny met Tilly the tortoise and together they went to the oak tree to look for a magical door.
scenes.image_prompt: bunny and tortoise walking together toward big tree, cheerful cartoon style

scenes.summary: They discover and open the magical door.
scenes.text: They found a tiny door in the tree and used the key to open it, entering a magical world.
scenes.image_prompt: small magical door in tree glowing as bunny opens it, fantasy cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: They enjoy the magical world and return home happily.
scenes.text: After exploring and making wishes with friends, they returned home feeling happy and excited for more adventures.
scenes.image_prompt: bunny and tortoise returning home smiling, soft magical sunset cartoon style

story: Benny the bunny found a glowing key in the meadow and wondered what it could open. He decided to visit the old oak tree and search for a door. On the way, he met his friend Tilly the tortoise, who joined him. Together they found a tiny door in the tree and used the key to open it. Inside, they discovered a magical world filled with wonder. They made wishes and played with friends. After their adventure, they returned home happily, ready for more magical journeys.
